sloka: अस्मद् व्यपेक्षान् सौमित्रे निरपेक्षान् गृहेष्व् अपि ।वृक्ष मूलेषु सम्सुप्तान् पश्य लक्ष्मण साम्प्रतम् ॥२-४६-१९॥
transliteration: asmad vyapekṣān saumitre nirapekṣān gṛheṣv api ।vṛkṣa mūleṣu samsuptān paśya lakṣmaṇa sāmpratam ॥2-46-19॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, son of Sumitra look at these people, fast alseep under the trees. Out of affection for us, they are even indifferent to their home.
